## [1.4.0](https://github.com/Prisoner-24601/custom-morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-11-12)

### ✨ New Features

* Add keyboard minimize shortcut, drop the shortcuts list ([03dfcd6](https://github.com/Prisoner-24601/custom-morphe-patches/commit/03dfcd6b36df47128979c3f9b3762aa6b7ae074e))

patches.name: DeArrow original titles
patches.description: Shows both the DeArrow title and the original title, instead of only the DeArrow title. Apply together with the Morphe YouTube patches, and turn on DeArrow titles in the Morphe settings.

options.description: Text between the DeArrow title and the original title.

patches.name: Keyboard comments shortcut
patches.description: Makes a key of a hardware keyboard (M by default) show and hide the comments of the video. Apply together with the Morphe YouTube patches 2.2 or newer, which this patch uses to show the comments.

options.description: The letter or digit key that shows and hides the comments.

patches.name: Keyboard fullscreen shortcut
patches.description: Makes a key of a hardware keyboard (F by default) enter and exit fullscreen while a video is open.

options.description: The letter or digit key that enters and exits fullscreen.

patches.name: Keyboard minimize shortcut
patches.description: Makes a key of a hardware keyboard (Esc by default) minimize the open video to the miniplayer, also from fullscreen or with the comments open.

options.description: The key that minimizes the video: Esc, Backspace, Tab, or a single letter or digit.

patches.name: Keyboard speed shortcuts
patches.description: Makes the - and = keys of a hardware keyboard decrease and increase the playback speed. Apply together with the Morphe YouTube patches, which this patch uses to change the speed.

options.description: How much each key press changes the playback speed, in hundredths of 1x (25 = 0.25x).
